For the holding of this Rule, and by the mea{{ls}}ure thereof, were al the holy Scriptures written. for and by the {{ls}}ame, al the glorious doctors haue made their {{ls}}ermons, commentaries, and interpretations of Gods word: al writings and interpretations no otherwi{{ls}}e admitted nor deemed to be of God, but as they be agreable to this Rule. {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Heretikes phanta{{ls}}tical rule, or rather rules of faith, many and diuers one from an other.}}And this is the {{ls}}ure Analogie and mea{{ls}}ure of faith, {{ls}}et downe and commended to vs euery where for the Apo{{ls}}tles tradition: and not the phanta{{ls}}tical rule or {{ls}}quare that euery Sectmai{{ls}}ter pretendeth to gather out of the Scriptures fal{{ls}}ely vnder{{ls}}tood and wre{{ls}}ted to his purpo{{ls}}e, by which they iudge of doctor, Scripture, Church, and al. Paul here and in other places {{ls}}peaketh of, and which was an exerci{{ls}}e in the primitiue Church, mea{{ls}}ured not by euery mans peculiar {{ls}}pirit, but by the former Rule of faith fir{{ls}}t {{ls}}et downe by the Apo{{ls}}tles.
